steps.subSkills: Motor planning: spatial planning
steps.textAr: يلا نعرف قدام الجاكيت وورا الجاكيت.
steps.textEn: Identifies the front and the back of the jacket

steps.subSkills: Hand skills: extends the hands to reach the jacket (reach); holds the edges of the jacket (grasp); lifts the jacket and moves it to the body (carry). Motor coordination: holds the jacket by both sides and spreads it out with both hands (symmetrical bilateral coordination)
steps.textAr: يلا نفتح الجاكيت ونجهزه علشان نلبسه.
steps.textEn: Opens the jacket and prepares it for putting on

steps.subSkills: Range of motion: extends the arms backward; bends and extends the elbows; inserts the arms into the sleeves. Motor coordination: stabilises the jacket with one hand and guides the other arm into the sleeve (asymmetrical bilateral coordination); follows the sleeve opening and the position of the arm with the eyes (visual-motor coordination). Midline crossing: extends one hand across the middle of the body to reach the sleeve on the opposite side
steps.textAr: يلا ندخل دراعنا الأولاني في الكم وبعدين الدراع التاني.
steps.textEn: Inserts the first arm into the sleeve and then the second arm

steps.subSkills: Range of motion: moves the shoulders to adjust the jacket; pulls the jacket onto the body. Motor coordination: inserts the arms and then adjusts the jacket on the shoulders (sequential motor coordination). Midline crossing: reaches with the hand to the edge of the jacket on the other side to adjust it on the body. Hand skills: lets go of the jacket after putting it on and adjusting it (release)
steps.textAr: يلا نسحب الجاكيت على كتافنا ونظبطه.
steps.textEn: Pulls the jacket onto the shoulders and adjusts it

steps.subSkills: Motor planning: sequential planning
steps.textAr: يلا نقفل الجاكيت من تحت لفوق بالترتيب.
steps.textEn: Fastens the jacket from bottom to top in order

steps.textAr: يلا ندور على السوستة أو الزراير.
steps.textEn: Locate the zipper or the buttons
Reach the zipper

steps.subSkills: Precision grasp; visual-motor coordination; identifying the grasping position and organising the start of the movement; reaching the zipper position, if that requires additional movement
steps.textEn: Grasp the zipper

steps.subSkills: Precision grasp, finger control, manipulating small objects; visual-motor coordination, bilateral coordination between the two hands; organising the grasping and pulling movement, identifying the pulling direction
steps.textEn: Open the zipper
Grasp both sides of the jacket
Move the jacket away from the body

steps.textAr: يلا نطلع دراعنا الأولاني من الكم.
steps.textEn: Take the first arm out of the sleeve

steps.textAr: يلا نطلع دراعنا التاني من الكم.
steps.textEn: Take the second arm out of the sleeve
Take the jacket off completely
Put the jacket in the designated place

steps.subSkills: Hand skills: extends the hand toward the T-shirt to reach it (reach); holds the two edges of the T-shirt with the fingers and the palm (grasp). Motor coordination: holds the two edges of the T-shirt with both hands to open it (symmetrical bilateral coordination)
steps.textAr: يلا نعرف اتجاه التيشيرت ونمسكه من المكان المناسب.
steps.textEn: Identifies the orientation of the T-shirt and holds it at the appropriate place

steps.subSkills: Motor planning: motor planning
steps.textAr: يلا نعرف فتحة الراس والأكمام قبل ما نبدأ نلبس.
steps.textEn: Identifies the head opening and the sleeves before starting to dress

steps.subSkills: Range of motion: raises the arms upward; bends and extends the elbows; raises the head to insert it into the T-shirt opening; inserts the arms into the sleeves. Motor coordination: stabilises the T-shirt with one hand and guides the other arm into the sleeve (asymmetrical bilateral coordination); directs the sleeve opening toward the arm while following the movement with the eyes (visual-motor coordination). Hand skills: lifts the T-shirt and moves it toward the body (carry). Midline crossing: extends the right hand across the middle of the body to reach the sleeve on the left side, and vice versa
steps.textAr: يلا ندخل راسنا في الفتحة بتاعتها، وبعدين ندخل دراعاتنا في الأكمام.
steps.textEn: Inserts the head through the opening intended for it, then inserts the arms into the sleeves

steps.subSkills: Range of motion: pulls the T-shirt downward. Motor coordination: inserts the arms and then pulls the T-shirt downward in sequential order (sequential motor coordination)
steps.textAr: يلا نسحب التيشيرت لتحت حركة ورا حركة بنظام.
steps.textEn: Pulls the T-shirt downward in a sequential, organised movement

steps.subSkills: Midline crossing: uses one hand to reach the edge of the T-shirt on the opposite side and adjust it. Hand skills: opens the hands and lets go of the T-shirt after securing it in place (release)
steps.textAr: يلا نظبط التيشيرت لحد ما يقعد على جسمنا.
steps.textEn: Adjusts the position of the T-shirt until it settles on the body

steps.subSkills: Hand skills: extends the hand to reach the shirt and the buttons (reach); holds the edges of the shirt and the buttons using the fingers (grasp); lifts the shirt and moves it to the body (carry). Motor coordination: spreads out the shirt and holds its two sides with both hands (symmetrical bilateral coordination)
steps.textAr: يلا نعرف اتجاه القميص وقدامه ووراه.
steps.textEn: Identifies the orientation of the shirt and its front and back

steps.subSkills: Range of motion: raises the arms; bends and extends the elbows; inserts the arms into the sleeves. Motor coordination: stabilises the shirt with one hand and inserts the other arm into the sleeve (asymmetrical bilateral coordination). Midline crossing: extends one hand across the middle of the body to reach the opposite sleeve
steps.textAr: يلا ندخل دراعاتنا في الأكمام بالترتيب.
steps.textEn: Inserts the arms into the sleeves in order

steps.subSkills: Range of motion: moves the hands in front of the body; brings the two sides of the shirt together
steps.textEn: Adjusts the shirt on the body

steps.subSkills: Range of motion: fastens the buttons in order. Motor coordination: directs the buttons toward the buttonholes and follows their position with the eyes (visual-motor coordination). Midline crossing: reaches with one hand to the buttons on the opposite side of the shirt; reaches the opposite buttonhole to insert the button into it
steps.textAr: يلا نبدأ نقفل الزراير من فوق لتحت.
steps.textEn: Begins fastening the buttons from top to bottom

steps.subSkills: Motor coordination: inserts the buttons into the buttonholes in sequence using both hands (sequential motor coordination). Hand skills: lets go of the shirt after adjusting it and fastening the buttons (release)
steps.textAr: يلا نقفل الزراير واحد ورا التاني بنفس السرعة.
steps.textEn: Fastens the buttons one after another at a regular rhythm

steps.subSkills: Motor planning: spatial planning
steps.textAr: يلا نعرف اتجاه البنطلون وفتحات الرجلين.
steps.textEn: Identifies the orientation of the trousers and the leg openings

steps.subSkills: Hand skills: extends the hand to reach the trousers (reach); holds the two edges of the trousers (grasp); lifts the trousers and moves them toward the feet and the body (carry). Motor coordination: holds the two sides of the trousers with both hands and opens them (symmetrical bilateral coordination)
steps.textAr: يلا نمسك البنطلون ونجهزه علشان نلبسه.
steps.textEn: Holds the trousers and prepares them for putting on

steps.subSkills: Range of motion: leans the trunk forward; bends the knees; lifts each foot to insert it into the trousers. Motor coordination: stabilises the trousers with one hand and guides the foot with the other (asymmetrical bilateral coordination); directs the foot toward the trouser opening while following it with the eyes (visual-motor coordination)
steps.textAr: يلا ندخل رجلنا الأولانية وبعدين رجلنا التانية في الفتحات بتاعتها.
steps.textEn: Inserts the first foot and then the second foot into the appropriate openings

steps.subSkills: Range of motion: extends the body to the upright position; pulls the trousers up to waist level. Motor coordination: inserts the feet and then pulls the trousers upward in sequence (sequential motor coordination). Midline crossing: uses the hand to reach the edge of the trousers on the other side while pulling them upward
steps.textAr: يلا نسحب البنطلون لفوق شوية شوية لحد وسطنا.
steps.textEn: Pulls the trousers upward gradually until they reach the waist

steps.subSkills: Midline crossing: extends one hand across the middle of the body to reach the opposite side of the trousers and adjust it. Hand skills: lets go of the trousers after adjusting them in place (release)
steps.textEn: Adjusts the position of the trousers around the waist

steps.subSkills: Hand skills: extends the hand to reach the sock (reach); holds the two edges of the sock with the fingers (grasp). Midline crossing: extends one hand across the middle of the body to reach the sock located beside the opposite foot
steps.textAr: يلا نعرف فتحة الشراب واتجاهه الصح.
steps.textEn: Identifies the opening of the sock and its correct orientation

steps.subSkills: Range of motion: opens the sock. Motor coordination: holds the two edges of the sock with both hands and opens it (symmetrical bilateral coordination). Hand skills: lifts the sock and moves it toward the foot (carry)
steps.textAr: يلا نفتح الشراب ونجهزه علشان ندخل رجلنا.
steps.textEn: Opens the sock and prepares it for inserting the foot

steps.subSkills: Range of motion: leans the trunk forward; bends one knee; lifts the foot in order to reach it; extends the hands toward the foot; inserts the toes and pulls the sock over the heel. Motor coordination: stabilises the sock with one hand and guides the toes with the other (asymmetrical bilateral coordination); directs the toes into the sock opening while following them with the eyes (visual-motor coordination)
steps.textAr: يلا ندخل صوابع رجلنا الأول وبعدين نسحب الشراب على كعبنا.
steps.textEn: Inserts the toes first and then pulls the sock over the heel

steps.subSkills: Motor coordination: pulls the sock gradually until it covers the foot (sequential motor coordination)
steps.textAr: يلا نسحب الشراب شوية شوية لحد مكانه الصح.
steps.textEn: Pulls the sock gradually until it reaches its correct position

steps.subSkills: Midline crossing: reaches with the hand to the edge of the sock on the opposite side to adjust it. Hand skills: lets go of the sock after pulling it on and securing it on the foot (release)
steps.textEn: Adjusts the position of the sock around the foot

steps.subSkills: Hand skills: extends the hand to reach the shoe (reach); holds the shoe by its edges (grasp). Midline crossing: extends one hand across the middle of the body to reach the shoe located beside the opposite foot
steps.textAr: يلا نعرف الجزمة المناسبة لكل رجل.
steps.textEn: Identifies the appropriate shoe for each foot

steps.subSkills: Range of motion: opens the shoe. Motor coordination: holds the shoe with both hands and opens it (symmetrical bilateral coordination). Hand skills: lifts the shoe and moves it toward the foot (carry)
steps.textAr: يلا نفتح الجزمة ونجهزها علشان ندخل رجلنا.
steps.textEn: Opens the shoe and prepares it for inserting the foot

steps.subSkills: Range of motion: leans the trunk forward; bends the knee; lifts the foot; extends the hand toward the shoe; inserts the foot and adjusts the heel. Motor coordination: stabilises the shoe with one hand and guides the foot with the other (asymmetrical bilateral coordination); directs the foot into the shoe while following its position with the eyes (visual-motor coordination)
steps.textAr: يلا ندخل رجلنا في الجزمة صح.
steps.textEn: Inserts the foot into the shoe in the correct way

steps.subSkills: Midline crossing: reaches with the hand to the outer part of the shoe to adjust its position if it is on the opposite side
steps.textEn: Adjusts the heel inside the shoe

steps.subSkills: Range of motion: fastens the shoe if it has a fastening mechanism. Motor coordination: adjusts the position of the shoe and fastens it if it has a lace or a hook-and-loop strap (sequential motor coordination). Hand skills: lets go of the shoe after putting it on and adjusting it (release)
steps.textAr: يلا نقفل الجزمة بالاسكوتش أو بالرباط.
steps.textEn: Fastens the shoe using the hook-and-loop strap or the laces
